name: Chebyshev Distance Map Empty Space Skipping
aliases: Chebychev distance maps for empty-space skipping
Chebychev distance maps for empty-space skipping (Deakin and Knackstedt)
definition: A technique using a distance map representing the Chebyshev distance to the nearest occupied block, allowing rays to skip multiple blocks in any dimension.
summary: Chebyshev Distance Map Empty Space Skipping is a ray-traversal acceleration technique that uses a pre-computed distance map to dynamically skip multiple empty voxels along a ray.
